## What

Describe the change and its reason. A behavior change includes its specification and implementation.

## Related issue

Link the issue, or state that none applies.

## Verification

List the commands run, their results, and the evidence location. State any environment limits or unverified behavior.

- [ ] Formatting, relevant checks, and tests pass.
- [ ] Changed behavior was exercised through the real entrypoint.
- [ ] Affected specifications and user documentation are current.
